items.text: Project Name: D2 MPDB
items.xml: Project Name:  D2 MPDB

items.text: This calculation determines longitudinal thermal movement of the two-span FIB 36 pedestrian bridge for joint and bearing detailing. The two simple spans are treated as one continuous deck unit with the center of movement at the intermediate pier. Geometry is referenced live from Bridge Geometry_2 Beam.

items.name: MovementScopeBox

rows.text: • Concrete-only superstructure temperature range is taken from FDOT SDG Table 2.7.1-1 .
• Center of movement is assumed at the intermediate pier; each end movement therefore uses the adjacent span length.
• This module calculates thermal movement only. Creep, shrinkage, skew resolution, and final expansion-joint or bearing capacity checks are separate design items.

items.text: 4. THERMAL MOVEMENT
items.xml:
<heading id="paragraphrefreturn0031">
            <paragraphlabel numbergroup="heading">4.</paragraphlabel>
            THERMAL MOVEMENT
        </heading>

items.text: For uniform temperature change, longitudinal movement is calculated from δ = α·ΔT·L. Temperature rise moves each end away from the intermediate pier; temperature fall moves each end toward the pier. For an end joint referenced to the approach, these correspond respectively to joint closing and opening.
